note: Well-formed user story, GWT criteria, small
title: Export monthly usage as CSV
statement: As a facility manager, I want to export monthly energy usage as a CSV file, so that I can share consumption trends with the finance team.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the Usage page, when I select a month and click Export, then a CSV with one row per day downloads
Given the month has no data, when I click Export, then I see the message 'No usage recorded for this month'

title: Password reset by email
statement: As a registered customer, I want to reset my password by email, so that I can regain access without calling support.
acceptance_criteria: Given I enter a registered email, when I submit, then a reset link is sent within 2 minutes
Given the link is older than 30 minutes, when I open it, then I see an expired-link error message

note: Enabler story with type and measurable criteria
title: Upgrade API gateway to supported version
statement: Upgrade the API gateway from version 2.x to 3.x in all environments to remove the end-of-support risk flagged by security.
acceptance_criteria: Given the upgrade is deployed, when the regression suite runs, then 100% of gateway tests pass
Given production traffic, when measured for 24 hours, then p95 latency is within 5% of the baseline

title: Filter orders by status
statement: As a warehouse supervisor, I want to filter open orders by status, so that I can prioritize shipments that are at risk of missing their delivery date.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the Orders list, when I choose the status 'Delayed', then only delayed orders are shown
Given a filter is applied, when I refresh the page, then the filter is still applied

title: Retain audit logs for 7 years
statement: Configure audit log retention to 7 years in the logging platform to meet the financial records retention policy.
acceptance_criteria: Given an audit event is written today, when retention settings are inspected, then the retention period shows 2555 days
Given a log older than 7 years exists, when the nightly job runs, then it is deleted

note: Minor issue (13 points) but otherwise strong; PO would accept and split in refinement
title: Bulk upload of product catalog
statement: As a merchandiser, I want to upload the product catalog from a spreadsheet, so that I can launch seasonal ranges in hours instead of days.

Given a row has a missing price, when I upload, then that row is rejected with an error message naming the row number
